corrections.finding: The question asks when Rachel may draw, the hand condition and card type, and whether a faceup emergency prevents it. It does not ask the draw amount. The map currently includes one action as part of its asked fact. This is the same quantity-versus-trigger distinction applied to the resolved payment finding.
corrections.material_required_scope: End of every deal including another player's, owner hand has zero actions, optional draw of owner sheet's topmost type, emergency outside hand does not prevent it.
corrections.correct_unasked_context: The fixed ability draws one action. A volunteered claim of two would still contradict the fixed key.
corrections.proposed_versioned_correction: In a future clause-map/key scope version, move the one-card quantity into context; retain all timing, zero-hand condition, optionality, owner/type and emergency treatment. Alternatively make the question explicitly ask how many; do not silently enlarge frozen wording.

corrections.finding: The final Jackson clause asks what produces the capital payment, which asks its condition. It does not ask how much is paid. The map includes gains two capital as an asked requirement, although activation cost is separately the exhaust cost.
corrections.material_required_scope: Predict when the asset is revealed, optional exhaust, another player rather than self, payment to Jackson user if the selected player wins the deal.
corrections.correct_unasked_context: The fixed payment is two capital. A volunteered wrong amount remains a material contradiction.
corrections.proposed_versioned_correction: In a future clause-map/key scope version, put the two-capital payment quantity in context and require the selected-player-win condition and recipient. Alternatively explicitly ask the payment amount in a new question version. Preserve the asked exhaust activation cost.
